metadata.notes: OFS-2 from official Mar-2017, Sep-2017, Dec-2021 and Sep-2026 bulletins; newest available publication among these snapshots wins each overlapping quarter. This is the published mixed-vintage history, not a reconstructed uniform vintage. Source PDF/page/month included per row. Original N/A or dash becomes blank, never inferred zero; source tokens retained. Fed AND government accounts are combined in this table. Privately held includes foreign investors. Private pensions include TSP G Fund; mutual funds include money market and closed-end funds. Insurance revisions described in saved footnotes. 0 component differences exceed rounding tolerance; see saved reconciliation report.
